evidence.note: Large dark serif title on a plain white background, high contrast, no texture or grain.
Three big white rounded cards with soft shadows and large dark labels (Install, 12 months measured, Go or stop review); no grid lines.
Connector arrows between cards are thin mid-grey lines (about 2 px) with small heads: the finest element on the slide, but they carry no text and the order is also clear from left-to-right layout.
Bullets (Blocks C and D; 64 kW, £86,400 installed; Five-year service plan) remain dark and readable at the small viewer size, with blue dash markers.
Nav links and brand line are small and grey but are deck chrome, still legible; the eyebrow '04 · PILOT' is small but saturated blue.

rationale: The slide is built from big soft shapes and generous, high-contrast type on a flat background, with no texture, grain or grid hairlines. The only thin strokes are the grey connector arrows, which are redundant with the left-to-right card order and would not lose meaning if softened by compression. Content text stays readable at 1288x598, matching the pass descriptor.
